title: Mehdi Debates Pete Hegseth’s Christian Nationalist Pastor Ally
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Do you ever wonder where Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth - who has
[repeatedly](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-
interactive/2026/apr/10/pete-hegseth-christianity-iran-war-crusade) framed the
U.S.'s deadly war on Iran as a divine mission - gets his "Christian" views
from? Or why he [says](https://www.cnn.com/2026/03/13/politics/hegseth-iran-
israel-war-american-crusade-analysis) that the U.S. was "founded as a
Christian nation" [despite](https://www.historynewsnetwork.org/article/the-us-
a-christian-nation-not-according-to-the-fou) the Constitution having zero
reference to Christianity?

In this wide-ranging and, at times, heated 'Mehdi Unfiltered' interview,
**Mehdi** grills Pastor **Douglas Wilson** - the self-described Christian
nationalist who
[Hegseth](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/02/18/doug-wilson-
pentagon-hegseth-christian-nationalist/) invited to preach at the Pentagon
earlier this year and who also founded the network of right-wing churches that
Hegseth is a member of.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Mehdi challenges Wilson on his vision for a Christian nationalist America -
which, according to Wilson, would
[eliminate](https://19thnews.org/2025/08/pete-hegseth-doug-wilson-women-
voting/) the 19th Amendment that granted women the right to vote,
[end](https://www.cnn.com/2025/08/07/politics/pastor-doug-wilson-christian-
domination-trump) gay marriage, and
[ban](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/06/nx-s1-5822558/pastor-doug-wilson-
interview-pete-hegseth) non-Christians from taking office.

Here are some of the other topics Mehdi presses Wilson on:

  * Whether the U.S. was founded as a Christian nation****(**" The actual real life U.S. Constitution is not theological at all," **Mehdi says)

  * Whether a Muslim like Mehdi should be allowed to run for office

  * Wilson's controversial book on slavery, which described [slavery](https://www.splcenter.org/resources/reports/doug-wilsons-religious-empire-expanding-northwest/) as a "relationship based upon mutual affection"

  * What would happen to U.S. states that want to keep gay marriage legal in Wilson's vision for America (**" I** _****_**believe that they should be expelled from the United States, " **Wilson says)

  * Hegseth's belligerent and very un-Christian [rhetoric](https://zeteo.com/p/hegseths-christian-crusade-iran-holy-war?utm_source=publication-search) on the war on Iran

  * Whether white evangelical Christians are hypocrites for supporting someone as openly sinful and un-Christian as Donald Trump
